attributions.surface_quote: the cult rendered to these gods was offered by reason of their being the mother, the brothers, or the sisters of the principal divinity.

attributions.surface_quote: had dwelt within Elam, which was not her proper place

attributions.surface_quote: she and the gods her fathers proclaimed my name to the dominion of the world. She intrusted to me the return of her divinity

canonical_statement: Divine entities can reveal ancient commands or prophecies to later generations.

attributions.surface_quote: The words of the command of her divinity, which she had spoken from remote days, she again revealed to the later people.

canonical_statement: Divine entities can experience joy.

attributions.surface_quote: she took the straight road, with joy of heart, to E-ana.

canonical_statement: Deities possess the power to direct and organize cosmic and earthly domains.

attributions.surface_quote: ASUR the great lord, the director of the hosts of the gods, the giver of the sceptre and the crown, the establisher of the kingdom

canonical_statement: Deities are the source of sovereignty and authority for earthly rulers.

attributions.surface_quote: Ye great gods, guiders of heaven (and) earth... with a crown supreme you have clothed him; to rule over the land of BEL mightily you have established him

attributions.surface_quote: the destiny of his lordship for his increase and supremacy... ASUR has predestined, and for the government of the four zones has proclaimed his name for ever

canonical_statement: Deities possess distinct attributes and domains of influence.

attributions.surface_quote: SIN (the Moon-god), the sentient one... SAMAS (the Sun-god), the judge of heaven and earth... RIMMON (the Air-god), the prince

canonical_statement: The will of deities is expressed through proclamations that confer power and legitimacy.

attributions.surface_quote: by the proclamation of SAMAS the illustrious sceptre has been given as a gift... by the proclamation of BEL he has no rival

canonical_statement: Divine entities can grant power and influence to human rulers, enabling them to expand their dominion and achieve military success.

attributions.surface_quote: May ASUR (and) the great gods who have magnified my kingdom, who have given increase and strength to my fetters

attributions.surface_quote: taken the tribute and gifts owing to ASUR my lord

attributions.surface_quote: Trusting in ASUR my lord I assembled my chariots and armies. Thereupon I delayed not.

canonical_statement: Divine entities issue commands that dictate the actions of earthly rulers.

attributions.surface_quote: ASUR the lord commanded (me) to march.

canonical_statement: The glory or power of a divine entity can directly influence the actions and morale of people.

attributions.surface_quote: The glory of ASSUR my lord overwhelmed them, and they descended and took my feet.

canonical_statement: Divine entities possess supreme power and everlasting grace, influencing earthly events and human actions.

attributions.surface_quote: through the supreme power of ASUR my lord, through the everlasting grace of SAMAS the warrior

attributions.surface_quote: great gods, who in the four zones rule in righteousness, and have no vanquisher

attributions.surface_quote: ASUR the lord urged me and I went.

attributions.surface_quote: The great gods, my lords, I introduced within;

canonical_statement: Deities are 'lords' of human beings.

attributions.surface_quote: The great gods, my lords,

attributions.surface_quote: the seat of their rejoicing, the habitation of their pleasure... the heart of their great divinities I gladdened.

attributions.surface_quote: ANU and RIMMON, the great gods I introduced within (it); on their thrones supreme I seated them.

attributions.surface_quote: have quickly completed (it), and have gladdened the heart of their great divinity

attributions.surface_quote: may they hearken to the earnestness of my prayer; abundant rains, years of fertility... may they give

attributions.surface_quote: the foes of ASUR, whom ANU and RIMMON have given for a spoil

attributions.surface_quote: may ANU and RIMMON the great gods in goodness of heart kindly conduct him!

attributions.surface_quote: may ANU and RIMMON the great gods, my lords, fiercely regard him and may they curse him

attributions.surface_quote: may he write his name along with mine. ... may he root out his name

canonical_statement: The universe originates from primordial elements.

attributions.surface_quote: The gods themselves come and go like mortal men; they are the offspring of the everlasting elements of the heaven and earth, and of that watery abyss out of which mythology had created a demon of evil, but which the philosopher knew to be the mother and source of all things.

canonical_statement: Deities are symbolic representations of fundamental cosmic elements.

attributions.surface_quote: The elementary spirits of the old Accadian faith have passed into the great gods of Semitic belief, and been finally resolved into mere symbolical representatives of the primordial elements of the world.

canonical_statement: The nature of deities can evolve or change over time within a mythological framework.

attributions.surface_quote: The Tiamat of the first tablet of the epic is a very different being from the Tiamat of the fourth.

canonical_statement: Philosophical materialism can underlie theological frameworks.

attributions.surface_quote: Under a thin disguise of theological nomenclature, the Babylonian theory of the universe has become a philosophic materialism.

canonical_statement: The current creation was preceded by an earlier, imperfect, and chaotic creation.

attributions.surface_quote: present creation had been preceded by an earlier creation, an imperfect and chaotic prototype

canonical_statement: The destruction of the chaotic prior creation by younger gods of light and order initiated the new creation of the visible world.

attributions.surface_quote: destruction of it by the younger gods of light and order ushered in the new creation

canonical_statement: Light and darkness, chaos and order, are in perpetual conflict.

attributions.surface_quote: Light and darkness, chaos and order, are ever struggling one against the other

canonical_statement: The victory of light and order over chaos is assured.

attributions.surface_quote: victory of light and order was assured ever since Merodach, the Sun-god, overthrew the dragon Tiamat

attributions.surface_quote: constitute two, Tavthe and Apason, making Apason the husband of Tavthe

canonical_statement: Tavthe is the mother of the gods.

attributions.surface_quote: denominating her 'the mother of the gods.'

canonical_statement: An 'intelligible world' (Mumis) proceeds from the two primary principles.

attributions.surface_quote: From these proceeds an only-begotten son Mumis, which, I conceive, is no other than the intelligible world

canonical_statement: The world was fabricated by a being named Belos.

attributions.surface_quote: Belos, who, they say, is the fabricator of the world.

canonical_statement: The universe originated from a primordial watery chaos.

attributions.surface_quote: A watery chaos alone existed, Mummu Tiamat, 'the chaos of the deep.'

canonical_statement: The created world emerged from the primordial chaos.

attributions.surface_quote: Out of the bosom of this chaos proceeded... the created world.

attributions.surface_quote: The heavens and earth had not yet been created.

attributions.surface_quote: before the younger gods could find a suitable habitation... it was necessary to destroy 'the dragon' of chaos.

canonical_statement: The creation of the present world was preceded by a state of watery chaos.

attributions.surface_quote: the present world has been preceded by a watery chaos.

canonical_statement: The process of creation unfolds in successive acts.

attributions.surface_quote: the history of the creation is divided into seven successive acts

canonical_statement: A primordial chaotic entity can be personified as a mythological being.

attributions.surface_quote: the deep has become a mythological personage, the mother of a chaotic brood.

attributions.surface_quote: The Assyrian epic is mythological and polytheistic.

canonical_statement: The first chapter of Genesis presents a sternly monotheistic spiritual conception.

attributions.surface_quote: The first chapter of Genesis is sternly monotheistic.

canonical_statement: The Babylonian belief system includes the concept that woman was produced from man.

attributions.surface_quote: Babylonians believed that the woman was produced from the man.

canonical_statement: Existence originated from an undifferentiated primordial state.

attributions.surface_quote: At that time the gods had not appeared, any of them... Then the (great) gods were created

attributions.surface_quote: no destiny (had they fixed)

attributions.surface_quote: He rode in the chariot of destiny that retreats without a rival.

attributions.surface_quote: On that day they exalted him, the gods exalted him, the gods his fathers exalted him.

attributions.chapter: FOURTH TABLET OF THE STORY OF THE CREATION
attributions.surface_quote: Stand up, and I and thou will fight together.

canonical_statement: The defeat of a primordial being can lead to the subjugation and punishment of its allied entities.

attributions.chapter: FOURTH TABLET OF THE STORY OF THE CREATION
attributions.surface_quote: When TIAMAT who marched before (them) was conquered, he dispersed her forces, her host was overthrown, and the gods her allies who marched beside her trembled (and) feared (and) turned their backs.

attributions.surface_quote: the lord trampled on the underpart of TIAMAT... he stripped her of (her) skin like a fish... overshadowed the heavens... made of her image the house of the Firmament.

canonical_statement: The structure of the cosmos, including the heavens, is a deliberate creation by a divine entity.

attributions.chapter: FOURTH TABLET OF THE STORY OF THE CREATION
attributions.surface_quote: He strengthens (his) mind (?), he forms a clever plan... he described her likeness and (with it) overshadowed the heavens... E-SARRA which he had created (to be) the heavens.

attributions.surface_quote: the chief prophet caused ANU, BEL and EA to inhabit as their stronghold. He prepared the mansions of the great gods.

canonical_statement: A 'Word' or 'saying' can possess real existence and be subject to creation, destruction, and re-creation.

attributions.surface_quote: The 'Word' is regarded as having a real existence which could be created, destroyed, and re-created.

canonical_statement: The universe was formed from the division of a primordial entity.

attributions.surface_quote: of one half of her he formed the earth, and of the other half the heavens

attributions.surface_quote: the other gods mixed the blood...with the earth, and from thence men were formed. On this account it is that they are rational and partake of divine knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: He prepared the twin mansions... He fixed the stars... He ordained the year...

attributions.surface_quote: He illuminated the Moon-god that he might be porter of the night, and ordained for him the ending of the night that the day may be known...

canonical_statement: Celestial bodies have prescribed functions and are commanded to adhere to them.

attributions.surface_quote: "Month by month, without break, keep watch in thy disk. At the beginning of the month light up the night..."

attributions.surface_quote: They fixed their habitations for the living creatures... They distributed in their dwelling-places the cattle...

canonical_statement: Deities possess the power to strengthen or destroy life forms.

attributions.surface_quote: the multitude of creeping things did I make strong. ...the seed of LAKHAMA did I destroy.

canonical_statement: The gods are capable of creating physical objects and structures.
